about.title: Charity, made transparent.
about.subtitle: Sahovat connects Uzbek donors with verified people, families and projects in need — and shows exactly where every som goes.
about.missionBody: We started Sahovat because we believe charity shouldn't be a leap of faith. Every campaign on the platform passes identity and document verification before it goes live, every donation flows through escrow, and every withdrawal is reviewed by a real person.
about.storyBody: Sahovat began in 2025 as a single weekend prototype after two friends tried — and failed — to find a trustworthy way to help a family with a sudden medical bill. The choice was either anonymous bank transfers or international platforms that didn't speak Uzbek and couldn't accept local cards. We thought Uzbekistan deserved better.
about.valuesIntro: Three principles guide every product decision we make.

transparency.title: Radical transparency
transparency.body: Every active campaign shows verified status, current balance, and donation history. Our platform fees are published, not hidden.

verification.title: Real verification
verification.body: We verify organizer identity through OneID and require supporting documents per campaign category. No anonymous fundraisers.

localFirst.title: Built for Uzbekistan
localFirst.body: Native PayMe and Click support, Uzbek/Russian/English UI, OneID identity, data stored in Uzbekistan per ZRU-547.

about.ctaBody: Find a verified campaign or start one of your own.

howItWorks.title: Two paths, one platform.
howItWorks.subtitle: Whether you're giving or raising, the steps are simple — and every step is designed to protect both sides.

donor.title: Give in under a minute.
donor.intro: No account required to make your first donation.
donor.step1Body: Browse verified campaigns by category, urgency, or location. Every campaign shows its verification status and current progress.
donor.step2Body: Pay any amount from 1,000 UZS upward. You can donate anonymously or under your name.
donor.step3Body: Both Uzbekistan-native payment methods are supported. Your card details never touch our servers.
donor.step4Body: Get a downloadable receipt by email or Telegram, and follow campaign updates as the goal is reached.
donor.ctaBody: Hundreds of verified causes are waiting.

organizer.title: Run a campaign people trust.
organizer.intro: From draft to first donation in 1–2 business days.
organizer.step1Body: We verify Uzbek citizens via OneID. This step happens once and unlocks campaign creation forever.
organizer.step2Body: Five short steps: category, story, goal, supporting documents, photos. Save a draft any time.
organizer.step3Body: Our admin team reviews every campaign manually. Most decisions arrive within one business day.
organizer.step4Body: Request withdrawals to your verified bank card. Each request is reviewed and paid within 1–3 business days.
organizer.ctaBody: Free to create. We only earn when you do — through a small platform fee on completed donations.

howItWorks.faqIntro: Everything below is also covered in the Help Center.

trustSafety.title: Trust isn't a tagline. It's a process.
trustSafety.subtitle: Every campaign, every donation and every withdrawal on Sahovat passes through controls designed to protect both donors and organizers.
trustSafety.verifyIntro: Three independent checks before a campaign goes live.

verify.step1Body: Organizers verify their legal identity through Uzbekistan's national OneID service. We can't fake this — and neither can fraudsters.
verify.step2Body: Each category requires specific evidence: medical bills for medical campaigns, school enrollment letters for education, etc. Uploaded privately, not public.
verify.step3Body: A real person on the Sahovat team reviews every submission before approval. No auto-approval, no shortcuts.

trustSafety.moneyBody: Donations don't sit in a single bank account that could vanish. Each campaign has its own virtual ledger, and funds are escrowed until the organizer requests a withdrawal — which itself is reviewed and matched against the verified organizer's identity.
trustSafety.moneyPoint1: Donations are escrowed per campaign in a virtual ledger.
trustSafety.moneyPoint2: Withdrawals are paid only to bank cards that match the verified organizer's name.
trustSafety.moneyPoint3: Failed or refunded payments never reach the organizer's balance.
trustSafety.moneyPoint4: All payments flow through licensed Uzbek processors (PayMe, Click).
trustSafety.fraudBody: If something looks wrong on a campaign — anywhere on the platform — tell us. We treat every report seriously and respond within one business day.
trustSafety.ctaBody: Read the Help Center or contact our team directly.

transparency.title: Open numbers, open process.
transparency.subtitle: We publish what we know — total raised, where it went, what we kept, and what's still in escrow.

transparency.feeNote: Platform fee covers verification, hosting, customer support, and admin review. Payment processing fees are passed through from PayMe and Click at cost.
transparency.dataBody: Per Uzbekistan's ZRU-547, all personal data of Uzbek users is stored on servers physically located in Uzbekistan. We do not transfer this data abroad and we do not sell it.

organizerGuidelines.title: What makes a campaign succeed.
organizerGuidelines.subtitle: Read this before you start — it's the difference between approval in hours and rejection in days.

checklist.item1Body: State who needs help and why in plain language. Avoid clickbait or all-caps.
checklist.item2Body: Write the story yourself — your own words, your own photos. Stock photos are a red flag.
checklist.item3Body: Goal should match the actual cost. Show a breakdown if the amount is large.
checklist.item4Body: Medical campaigns need bills or doctor's notes. Educational campaigns need enrollment letters.

organizerGuidelines.documentsIntro: Documents are uploaded privately. Donors never see them — only the admin review team.

documents.medical: Hospital invoices, prescriptions, doctor's referral, or treatment plan.
documents.education: Enrollment letter, tuition invoice, or scholarship denial letter.
documents.emergency: Police report, official damage assessment, or photo evidence.
documents.community: Project proposal with budget breakdown and at least one community endorsement.
documents.creative: Project description, samples of past work, and detailed budget.
documents.business: Business registration, financial plan, and clear use of funds.

organizerGuidelines.prohibitedIntro: Campaigns matching any of the below are rejected without exception.

prohibited.item1Body: Fabricated stories, inflated diagnoses, or staged photos.
prohibited.item2Body: We're a humanitarian platform. No party donations, no religious building projects.
prohibited.item3Body: Anything that violates Uzbek law — including unlicensed medical claims.

organizerGuidelines.photosBody: Three to five real photos, taken yourself, lit naturally, no heavy filters. The best campaigns include a photo of the person or family you're raising for (with their consent) plus context photos (the home, the project site, the diagnosis).
organizerGuidelines.withdrawalsBody: You can request a withdrawal at any time after your first verified donation. Each request is reviewed against your verified identity and paid to your bank card within 1–3 business days. Platform fee and any payment processing fees are deducted automatically.
organizerGuidelines.ctaBody: Create a campaign now or contact us first if you have questions.
